title: The Winter of Cold Spring
author: I. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Orsen Kavanagh, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
